criteria.rationale: Verified the marker's containment and both guarded acceptance paths. Independently reran targeted tests and their race-enabled variants. The harne8 execution log remains implementer evidence, not an independently repeated reproduction.
The marker is set on a value copy of Store, introducing no shared mutable synchronization state. Traced checkIndexInputs and the removed local closeout reentry. Targeted race-enabled tests passed.
No exported signatures, serialized fields, CLI arguments or MCP schemas changed.
Resolver authorization, identity validation, graph validation, source status and bounded error paths remain in place.
Traced material construction through roadmap acceptance and source resolution. External source proof and ordinary closeout acceptance retain their existing gates.
Existing actionable resolver errors and closeout blockers remain available outside material computation; no sensitive logging was added.

Examined Store and acceptance changes. The private marker changes only material computation; without policy adoption the formerly conditional local closeout blocker was already absent. Public contracts remain compatible.
The material path skips local terminal projection, while the ordinary path still rejects an unclosed predecessor. Independently executed the new regression, RoundSix and material tests successfully.

D1 removes the circular dependency rather than making input verification reentrant. BuildIndexFederatedMaterialIn marks its Store copy; federatedAcceptance and AggregateDependencyClosed suppress terminal projection only in that context, implementing R1 while preserving R2. No individual structural fact IDs were listed in the brief.

Compared the spec's requirements, D1, validation strategy and residual-risk statement with runtime behavior and the permanent validation-matrix command. No public operational contract requires a scaffold migration.

Ordinary closeout still reports closeout-not-terminal and retains explicit close remediation. Material computation avoids asking the local terminal projection responsible for the documented self-wait.

R1 is supported by the guarded implementation and receipt-read regression; R2 by ordinary acceptance and RoundSix. R3 is supported by removing the documented reentry path and the spec's before/after execution log. The independent targeted and race runs passed.
Examined the complete requested diff, artifact declarations and start record. Implementation is confined to the material marker, its two consumers, regression coverage and validation registration.

Reviewed authorization, canonical identity, path confinement, graph validity, source verification and external proof boundaries. The marker is private and cannot be supplied through public input; ordinary authority gates remain enforced.

A private per-computation flag with two guards is a small cohesive correction. D1's reentrant-check alternative would replace the hang with unknown material. No new cache, framework or public mode was introduced. This choice must be revisited if another local material path begins reading index-derived terminal state.
